Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno, drug_mechanism.tid = target_dictionary.tid, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4, drug_mechanism.action_type = 'INHIBITOR'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, max_phase ASC, mechanism_of_action ASC, action_type ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC.
